Tom — thank you for flagging this.

Quick summary of what I see: Redwood's invite was a Google Meet link by default; it looks like your proxy is sanitizing the description and stripping external URLs. We can (A) attach an .ics as a standalone invite which often bypasses the proxy, (B) provide a one-time ephemeral Bridge link that we host (no SSO required), or (C) move to a Zoom join where we can provide phone dial-in.

Ben and Lauren — can you weigh in on the ephemeral Bridge flow? We have a partner (PartnerBridge) that can spin up single-use room links with a PIN; vendor contact is ivan@partnerbridge.io. If we go that route, I’ll attach the ICS and a short instruction PDF.

Tom — which option is least-friction for your contractors? If we do the Bridge, we’ll also email instructions to your Security team so it fits your review process.

Thanks,
